technology_name: Spice-Based Green Tea Bag Dips Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for functional tea beverages with antidiabetic health benefits.
description: Processes for producing green tea and spice bag dips blended with herbs, spices, and medicinal plants. The formulation encapsulates active ingredients evaluated for antidiabetic properties, processed using milling, drying, and packing equipment.
applications: • Manufacturing of functional antidiabetic tea blends • Production of microencapsulated herbal tea bags • Processing of therapeutic botanical beverages • Formulation of clinical health and wellness drinks
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
